findings.title: Engine/version drift
findings.acceptance: Pin a new main-based integration tree; port spill changes with tests; record resolved policy and complete source identity.

findings.title: Per-projection MoE policy versus fused loader
findings.acceptance: Save and load a representative ordinary/special MoE fixture using the exact consumer, dtype and tensor parallelism.

findings.title: Malformed checkpoint accepted by structural gate
findings.acceptance: Reject missing or malformed tensors, group/dtype mismatches and preservation/index violations before GPU admission.

findings.title: Successful exit overwrites status as failure
findings.acceptance: Normal exit never rewrites passed, not-ready or blocked status; JSON and process outcomes agree.

findings.title: False-positive answer smoke and conflated errors
findings.acceptance: Validate answers per prompt; distinguish load errors, wrong answers and workload qualification.

findings.title: Weak unbound pilot approval
findings.acceptance: Bind pilot to code/source/calibration/policy and qualify export/load including the unique layer-10 case.

findings.title: Required assertions disappear under optimization
findings.acceptance: Normal and optimized Python reject identical invalid source fixtures using explicit exceptions.

findings.title: Incomplete abort and retry state
findings.acceptance: Fault-inject failures; preserve terminal state; provide isolated retries or sequentially valid resume without overwriting artifacts.

findings.title: Dense batch numbering in sparse native spill
findings.acceptance: Validate sparse native/replay alignment or reject unsupported combinations; current campaign has GPTAQ disabled.
